holidays.name: National Apple Betty Day
holidays.description: A day for the humble, cozy apple dessert also known as Brown Betty. Sliced apples are layered with buttery, sweetened bread crumbs and baked until bubbly and golden. Warm it up, add cinnamon, and top it with ice cream.
holidays.origin: The dessert was first mentioned in print in 1864. It grew out of the thrifty American habit of turning stale bread and autumn apples into something delicious.
holidays.funFact: Apple Betty is a recipe born of frugality. Bread crumbs stood in for pricier pastry crust, so a leftover heel of bread became dessert.

holidays.name: National Get Funky Day
holidays.description: A day to loosen up, turn on a groove, and dance like nobody is watching. Funk music, wild outfits, and unapologetic boogie moves are all encouraged.
holidays.origin: It was created in 2017 by Funkytown Fitness in St. Augustine, Florida, to encourage people to embrace their funky side.
holidays.funFact: Funk music is built on a heavy emphasis on the first beat of the measure, known as 'the one', a trick that has made people move since the 1960s.

holidays.name: National Kiss a Wrestler Day
holidays.description: A playful, internet-born observance that invites fans to show some love to the grapplers of the squared circle. Smooches are best given with consent, of course, and perhaps to a friendly wrestler in a good mood.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin that has spread through fun-holiday calendars.
holidays.funFact: Pro wrestling is famous for its dramatic storylines, and many wrestlers have a long tradition of blowing kisses to crowds as part of their showmanship.
